name: Chest Tunic
shortDescription: A leather reinterpretation of an Egyptian-inspired tunic, upgraded with real leather, metal armor pieces, and an added back plate.
description: This tunic was based on a purchased Amazon design with an Egyptian-inspired appearance. Rather than reproducing the original materials, I rebuilt the concept using real leather in place of felt and metal in place of the original pleather guard.
I also expanded the design by adding a back plate, turning the original inspiration into a more substantial armored tunic.

details.Modifications: Metal guard and added back plate
